{{Lang|Zhiyu|zh=知雨|zh_rm=Zhīyǔ}} is an NPC in {{Location|Memento Square}}.

==Location==
Zhiyu can be found in Memento Square after completing the quest [[Utterance of Marvels: II]].

<gallery>
NPC Location Zhiyu.png|Zhiyu's location
NPC Location Zhiyu Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Profile==
Zhiyu is a [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Ranger]] with the ability to sense incoming rainfall. Though he once believed his [[Forte]] was useless, serving on an exploratory team has given him increased confidence. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Zhiyu}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Zhiyu:''' Did you know water can speak?
:{{DIcon}} Sure, like "Splish, splash" or "Drip, drop"?
:'''Zhiyu:''' Haha, very funny. No, I mean...
:'''Zhiyu:''' It's more like... the raindrops in the clouds are talking to me, telling me when they're coming and how long they'll stay.
:{{DIcon}} You're saying the rain talks to you?
:'''Zhiyu:''' Nah, I can only hear regular rain. When it's that Retroact stuff? Nothing.
:{{DIcon}} [[Retroact Rain]]?
::'''Zhiyu:''' Technically, Retroact Rain isn't even real rain. It's more like... [[Remnant]] Energy.
::'''Zhiyu:''' Remnant Energy replays old events. When the rain flows up, you get these mirages of the past showing up in it.
::'''Zhiyu:''' If you can't tell what's real and what's not, those mirages can mess with your head. I guess everyone's got someone they can't let go of...
::'''Zhiyu:''' So if you run into Retroact Rain, stay sharp. Don't let your emotions get the better of you.
::'''Zhiyu:''' I can't hear the Retroact Rain, only the ordinary kind... Do you think my Resonance Ability is weak?
:{{DIcon}} Makes sense.
::'''Zhiyu:''' You won't hurt my feelings if you tell me that this kind of Resonance Ability... is kind of useless.
:'''Zhiyu:''' I used to feel insecure about it, but since I started working on the Exploration Canal, my skills have been super helpful.
:'''Zhiyu:''' I realized that there is no such thing as a strong or weak ability, it's how you use it that matters.
{{Dialogue End}}
